instruction.text: Margaret wants to plant a new hedge in her garden. First, she needs to find out the length of her garden. Write the length of the missing side.
Margaret is thinking of also planting a flower border along the border of her garden. What is the perimeter of her garden? Fill in the gaps to find the perimeter.
Margaret would like to split her vegetable patch at an angle to create a path. Fill in the gaps to find the size of the missing angle.
Nick takes his dog for a walk in the fields. He walks all four sides of the field. How far does he walk?
He decides to cut across the field at an angle. Fill in the gaps to find the missing angle.
Anya and Colin are measuring the size of a piece of A4. They have measured the size of one pair of parallel sides and they know that the perimeter is 102 cm.

atoms.a: First, find the sum of the lengths of the known pair of sides.
Next, subtract your answer from the perimeter, to calculate the sum of the lengths of the other pair of sides.
Finally, divide the answer by two to find the length of the missing sides.

instruction.text: Anya and Colin want to cut the piece of paper at an angle. Fill in the gaps to find the missing angle.
